messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your updated volume forecast of 6,110 pieces and welcome the proposed 14-day payment terms. Your request for a cost breakdown has been forwarded to our specialists for a separate reply, though our calculation is our property and we do not share a breakdown.

We can accept your terms and await your order. Ourangebot provides a price of €355.93 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
